Highly recommend this dental clinic :)

The dentist was professional and efficient. I got four fillings at a very reasonable price.

It’s also in a very convenient location—I can get there from my hotel (close to Asiatique) by Grab in about 10 minutes. Plus, it’s just opposite Terminal 21, very “tourist friendly.” My friends can go shopping while I’m getting my teeth cleaned. Will visit again for the next trip to Thailand.

The clinic is very clean, the staff are warm and welcoming, and the doctor is kind and attentive. Everything was explained clearly and in detail, and the doctor has a very gentle touch. I was truly impressed with the experience.😊🦷✨ …

OMG this place is sooooo good the doctor are very trained when I went there they took out one of my teeth and it didn't even hurt a little bit I blinked once and the tooth was out already. This place is also very clean it is better than most clinic out there, they have free water and the staff are really kind. When I went the doctor also made me find out stuff I didn't even knew I had. This place really cares about your teeth but also your whole face, I thought I came to check out my teeth but it was more like a whole face scan. They have X-ray and many other things that are really high tech compare to other places. I highly recommend for people and the place is also really easy to find it is close to KFC.
